set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- {}]
#[{httpStatus: 400, code: 'APIKIT_BAD_REQUEST', message: 'Request failed RAML validation'}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set errorContext

set-variable.value: #[{httpStatus: 404, code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Resource not found'}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set errorContext

set-variable.value: #[{httpStatus: 405, code: 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', message: 'Method not allowed'}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set errorContext

set-variable.value: #[{httpStatus: 406, code: 'NOT_ACCEPTABLE', message: 'Not acceptable'}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set errorContext

set-variable.value: #[{httpStatus: 415, code: 'UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE', message: 'Unsupported media type'}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set errorContext

set-variable.value: #[{httpStatus: 501, code: 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED', message: 'Not Implemented'}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set errorContext

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { idempotencyKey: vars.idempotencyKey, externalOrderId: vars.externalOrderId, orderSource: payload.orderSource }]

set-variable.doc:name: Set errorContext
set-variable.value: #[{ httpStatus: 400, code: "PRICING_VALIDATION_FAILED", message: "Pricing mismatch detected" }]

when.expression: #[(payload.payment.paymentMethodType == "CARD" and (payload.payment.paymentToken == null or payload.payment.paymentToken == "") ) or ((payload.payment.authorizedAmount default 0) != (payload.pricing.grandTotal default 0))]

set-variable.doc:name: Set errorContext
Set originalOrder
set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- payload]

set-variable.doc:name: Set requestHash
set-variable.value:
#[%dw 2.0 import hashWith from dw::Crypto import toHex from dw::core::Binaries output application/java
var canonicalRequest = vars.requestPayload - "requestTimestamp" - "traceId" - "correlationId"
var canonicalString = write(canonicalRequest, "application/json", {indent: false})
--- toHex( hashWith( canonicalString as Binary, "SHA-256" ) )]

set-variable.doc:name: Set generatedOrderId
set-variable.value: #["ORD-" ++ vars.externalOrderId]

db:select.doc:name: Select idempotencyRecord
db:select.db:sql: SELECT idempotency_key, external_order_id, internal_order_id, request_status, response_code, response_body::text AS response_body, request_hash FROM api_idempotency WHERE idempotency_key = :idempotencyKey

set-variable.doc:name: Set errorContext
set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { httpStatus: 409, code: "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT", message: "The idempotency key was already used for a different external order" }]

when.expression: #[!isEmpty(vars.idempotencyRecord) and vars.idempotencyRecord[0].external_order_id == vars.externalOrderId and vars.idempotencyRecord[0].request_hash != null and vars.idempotencyRecord[0].request_hash != vars.requestHash]

set-variable.doc:name: Set errorContext

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- read( vars.idempotencyRecord[0].response_body as String, "application/json" )

set-variable.doc:name: Set httpStatus
set-variable.value: #[vars.idempotencyRecord[0].response_code default 202]

set-variable.doc:name: Set errorContext
set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { httpStatus: 409, code: "REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS", message: "A request with this idempotency key is already being processed" }]

db:select.doc:name: select existingOrder
db:select.db:sql: SELECT order_id, external_order_id, order_status FROM orders WHERE external_order_id = :externalOrderId

set-variable.doc:name: Set errorContext
set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { httpStatus: 409, code: "DUPLICATE_ORDER", message: "An order with this externalOrderId already exists" }]

on-error-continue.doc:name: Handle Business Errors
on-error-continue.type: ORDER:PRICING_VALIDATION_FAILED, ORDER:BUSINESS_ERROR, ORDER:IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, ORDER:REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS, ORDER:DUPLICATE_ORDER, ORDER:IDEMPOTENCY_PAYLOAD_CONFLICT

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- {orderId: vars.generatedOrderId default payload.externalOrderId default null}]

on-error-continue.doc:name: Handle Concurrent Duplicate
on-error-continue.when: #[((error.description default '') contains 'duplicate key') or ((error.detailedDescription default '') contains 'duplicate key')]

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- {orderId: vars.generatedOrderId default null, idempotencyKey: vars.idempotencyKey default null}]

set-variable.doc:name: Set errorContext

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- {orderId: vars.generatedOrderId default payload.externalOrderId default null}]

set-variable.doc:name: Set eventId
set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- "EVT-" ++ vars.generatedOrderId ++ "-" ++ (now() as String {format: "yyyyMMddHHmmss"})]
#[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { orderId: vars.generatedOrderId, eventId: vars.eventId, action: "INSERT_ORDER_AND_OUTBOX_IDEMPOTENCYKEY" }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Idempotency Record
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO api_idempotency ( idempotency_key, external_order_id, internal_order_id, request_hash, request_status ) VALUES ( :idempotencyKey, :externalOrderId, :internalOrderId, :requestHash, :requestStatus )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { idempotencyKey: vars.idempotencyKey, externalOrderId: vars.externalOrderId, internalOrderId: vars.generatedOrderId, requestHash: vars.requestHash, requestStatus: "PROCESSING" }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Order
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO orders ( order_id, external_order_id, order_status, order_payload, correlation_id ) VALUES ( :orderId, :externalOrderId, :orderStatus, CAST(:orderPayload AS JSONB), :correlationId )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { orderId: vars.generatedOrderId, externalOrderId: vars.externalOrderId, orderStatus: vars.orderStatus, orderPayload: write(vars.requestPayload, "application/json"), correlationId: vars.requestCorrelationId }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Outbox Event
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO order_outbox( event_id, event_type, event_version, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_payload, event_status, retry_count, correlation_id ) VALUES ( :eventId, :eventType, :eventVersion, :aggregateType, :aggregateId, CAST(:eventPayload AS JSONB), :eventStatus, :retryCount, :correlationId )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { eventId: vars.eventId, eventType: "ORDER_CREATED", eventVersion: "1.0", aggregateType: "ORDER", aggregateId: vars.generatedOrderId, eventPayload: write({ eventId: vars.eventId, eventType: "ORDER_CREATED", eventVersion: "1.0", orderId: vars.generatedOrderId, correlationId: vars.requestCorrelationId, sourceSystem: "order-experience-api", createdAt: now() }, "application/json"), eventStatus: vars.outboxStatus, retryCount: 0, correlationId: vars.requestCorrelationId }]

set-variable.doc:name: Set successResponse
set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { status: "ACCEPTED", code: "ORDER_ACCEPTED", message: "Order and outbox event persisted successfully", orderId: vars.generatedOrderId, externalOrderId: vars.externalOrderId, correlationId: vars.requestCorrelationId, data: { orderStatus: vars.orderStatus, outboxStatus: vars.outboxStatus, eventId: vars.eventId } }]

db:update.db:sql: UPDATE api_idempotency SET request_status = :requestStatus, response_code = :responseCode, response_body = CAST(:responseBody AS JSONB), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE idempotency_key = :idempotencyKey
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { requestStatus: "COMPLETED", responseCode: 202, responseBody: write(vars.successResponse, "application/json"), idempotencyKey: vars.idempotencyKey }]

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { orderId: vars.generatedOrderId default null, eventId: vars.eventId default null, message: "Order and outbox transaction failed and will be rolled back" }]

#[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { orderId: vars.generatedOrderId, eventId: vars.eventId, orderStatus: "RECEIVED", outboxStatus: "PENDING", message: "Order and outbox event committed successfully" }]
